content.comment_body: Hello, Is [company_name] considering replacing the microSD card interface on [product_name] hardware with a USB interface? This change might improve reliability and make handling easier. Best regards, [user_name]
Only [company_name] can provide a definitive answer to this question, not forum users. You could reach out directly to [company_name] via a Support Request.
Why change? The device includes a LAN connection for communication, and I've never seen a USB stick as compact as an SD card. Regards, [user_name] (translated by Google)

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are discussing whether the microSD card interface could be replaced with a USB interface in [product_name] hardware. Users highlight the potential benefits of USB for reliability and ease of use, while others note the advantage of SD cards' compactness and mention that LAN connectivity already supports data transfers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a memory interface for [product_name] devices that is more reliable and easier to handle, specifically preferring USB over the current microSD card slot.
